summary_en: 135,000 shares (0.7% of S/O) | ¥200M limit | ¥1,481/share maximum implied | open-market purchase | Aug 19–Nov 30, 2026 | rationale: enhanced shareholder returns and corporate value improvement
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Treasury Stock Acquisition
translation_en_brief: On 18 August 2026, Serendip Holdings announced a treasury stock acquisition program approved by the board of directors. The company will acquire up to 135,000 ordinary shares (0.7% of shares outstanding excluding treasury, based on 18,203,176 shares ex-treasury as of 31 July 2026) for an aggregate ceiling of ¥200 million via open-market purchase. The acquisition period runs from 19 August 2026 to 30 November 2026. The stated rationale is to strengthen shareholder returns and enhance corporate value, based on comprehensive consideration of the stock's market valuation, financial condition, and future investment opportunities. The implied maximum acquisition price is approximately ¥1,481 per share (¥200M ÷ 135,000 shares).
